lidarr.name: Lidarr
lidarr.description: Downloads albums through Lidarr. Lidarr grabs and files each album in its own folder, and Aurral plays it from there.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.description: Finishes the tags on new downloads and on albums you choose: embeds the cover, saves lyrics, adds release details from MusicBrainz, cleans out junk tags, and adds ReplayGain.

road-trip.name: Road Trip
road-trip.description: Turns Google Maps directions into a playlist as long as the drive, with songs named after the towns you pass and artists from those towns, in the order you reach them.

setlists.name: Setlists
setlists.description: Imports setlist.fm links as playlists: one show in order, or an artist's current tour with every song played on it so far.
